title: Captions for TikTok, Reels, Shorts & More
metaDescription: Burned-in captions for each short-video platform: the right crop, where the app's interface covers the frame, and a caption style that fits.
intro: Every platform crops, covers and plays your video a little differently. These guides cover the export format, where the app's interface sits over the frame, and which caption style reads best there.

faq.question: Can I use one video on several platforms?
faq.answer: Yes. Burned-in captions are part of the picture, so they stay on the video wherever you post it. You can also export the same project again in another format, such as 9:16 or 1:1.

faq.question: Which formats can I export?
faq.answer: As uploaded, or cropped to 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9. The crop always fills the frame, with no black bars, and you can slide the framing to keep the subject in view.

faq.question: Do the captions show with the sound off?
faq.answer: Yes. They're burned into the video, so viewers see them without turning anything on, on any device.
